game_title: Trace Table Race – Market Square Defense
game_concept: A survival strategy set in The Kingdom – Market Square, a bustling cobbled market square: the royal scribe must handle thieves while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Trace Table Race: Fill a trace table showing each variable after every line of a mini program.
theme: The Kingdom – Market Square: a bustling cobbled market square
core_gameplay_loop: In Market Square, repeat each round: Fill a trace table showing each variable after every line of a mini program. Each round, thieves strike the wall banner, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the trace_rows_correct value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the wall banner from thieves in Market Square: keep the trace_rows_correct meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 36-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: trace_rows_correct drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 36-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 6 (applied tier): Trace Table Race
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Trace Table Race' (Week 1 slot 14), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Market Square'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how trace_rows_correct changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against thieves in Market Square.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 36 seconds while trace_rows_correct > 0.
